title: #138 Typing
prompt: Some schools believe that children should learn typing rather than handwriting. To what extent do you agree with that? Give reasons with your experience.

promptSegments.text: Some schools believe that children should learn typing rather than handwriting.
To what extent do you agree with that?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Typing is a fast and helpful method for school work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Typing is a fast and helpful method for school work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Typing is a better skill to learn than handwriting because it is much faster.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Typing is a better skill to learn than handwriting because it is much faster.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Handwriting is a physical skill that builds hand strength and control.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Handwriting is a physical skill that builds hand strength and control.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Handwriting is a mental skill that helps children organize and structure their thoughts.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Handwriting is a mental skill that helps children organize and structure their thoughts.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Typing is presented as a more efficient method for school assignments because it allows students to produce written text much faster than writing by hand.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Typing is presented as a more efficient method for school assignments because it allows students to produce written text much faster than writing by hand.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, learning typing is crucial for future job success, as most modern workplaces require employees to use computers for daily tasks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, learning typing is crucial for future job success, as most modern workplaces require employees to use computers for daily tasks.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Handwriting provides physical and developmental benefits that typing cannot fully replace.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Handwriting provides physical and developmental benefits that typing cannot fully replace.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The process of handwriting strengthens cognitive skills, such as memory and concentration, which is vital for overall learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The process of handwriting strengthens cognitive skills, such as memory and concentration, which is vital for overall learning.
